_about: Frederic Bastiat (1801-1850) in English versions whose translators are not named: Essays on Political Economy, third (People's) edition (New York: Putnam; London: Provost, 1874), and Protection and Communism, with a preface by the translator (London: John W. Parker and Son, MDCCCLII), clean Gutenberg texts. Patrick James Stirling's translations (Sophisms, Harmonies) are lane C's stirling-bastiat shelf, and two American adaptations sit on singles-ideas; neither is taken again. Held: The Law (PG 44800), because the etext is the Mises Institute's 2007 edition. US public domain. No uids minted.

bastiat-essays-political-economy-1874: Essays on Political Economy, third (People's) edition (Putnam, 1874)
bastiat-protection-and-communism-1852: Protection and Communism (London: J. W. Parker, 1852)
